body:
Closed a distinct **portable Transport homogeneous-opcode carrier** screen on canonical source `a68fcb6a`. This reuses the previously offline portable prototype; it does not repeat the rejected native trial.

[Preserved source, raw owners, actual ordinary-driver code and original ABBA](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/018c7254dc0b6c322c1cfb4dc6e431bb565a52ef/attestations/qualification/a68fcb6a/portable-transport-opcode-cost).

- Actual called LLVM/JIT code has scalar `i32` opcode checks on the homogeneous path and the original vector mixed-layer fallback. Executable text grows 879,837→1,089,117 bytes; coroutine frame 89,024→109,536 bytes. All 55 enabled features, queue/extensions/chain agree; `shaderInt64=0`.
- Current 117+42 generated layers have homogeneous cohorts. The changed module is private; all 40 primary and 2 owner arrays per executable are bound. The observer object is reused after 518 dependency joins; the original 174,268-record scalar corpus is reused after relevant current provider/arithmetic joins.
- The sole unchanged original A1/B1/B2/A2 control passes C8 assertions, all 32 complete readbacks and 54 actual command/module joins per slot. **REJECT 8/20**, while **2/2 provisioning-inclusive API gates pass**. Four whole-call gains, in separate forward/reverse orders: **+3.618885%, +3.730010%, +0.064880%, −8.268380%**; all miss ≥5%. An independent raw-XML Decimal calculation agrees on all 22 decisions.
- Seven current owners pass; 5,716 distinct frozen inputs are rehashed and all recorded current births retired. Old stock reuse was refused on two changed frozen host libraries; one current stock capture replaces it. Preparatory reader failures are retained.

No production adoption, unchanged retry, pooling, subtraction, remaining seven controls or failed-frame rerun. Scalar opcode dispatch alone is insufficient. Source/build and this finite control do not establish full scientific, rendering or installed-release qualification; #44 remains open.
